items.text: Today, we have a hotfix for Bus Bound on Steam that improves PC performance by removing periodic micro-stutters caused by background checks for DLC and display settings.
If you run into any other issues in the game, please contact our support team here.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652091/74fde4e539b0392b65b6d6ab305230bbe00964b6.jpg"]
Today, we bring you a quality-of-life update across all platforms that introduces mouse steering and TrackIR support, along with several bug fixes.
If you run into any issues in the game, please contact our support team via this form.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652091/7bf6fbf8662576fdf6df7abde277c40197184c8e.jpg"]
Steering: Added mouse steering to enhance your gaming experience.
Peripherals: Added TrackIR support to the game.
Gameplay
Adjusted the harsh braking incident to be slightly more forgiving for a smoother experience with small buses, especially the Horizon Chamois.
NPV
Tweaked the tractor wheel base color for a better visual effect while the vehicle is moving.
Traffic Events
Reduced some DLC event spawn probabilities in various places due to players' feedback that they cause too many traffic issues if a lot of them spawn at once.
Pedestrians
Reduced population in the Old Town Roads DLC countryside area.
Loading Screen
Tweaked two cars in the loading screen picture (from Main Menu to the Office) to look more visually accurate.
Bus
Adjusted the rear light illumination intensity of the Letenda bus.
Fixed the invisible collision in the onboarding drive area (Open Map).
Fixed texture scaling artifacts of the hard road patches.
Tweaked obstacles around some traffic events, as well as the NPV actors, to prevent traffic from getting stuck.
Pedestrians
Fixed pedestrian paths around the city to prevent them from visibly despawning.
UI
Driver's Guide text is no longer trimmed when switching languages.

topNew: Peripherals: Added TrackIR support to the game.

items.text: Today, the ‘Old Town Roads’ update for Bus Bound releases on all platforms, adding two new districts in the city’s historic outskirts, a new Horizon “Chamois” minibus, and new on-road events that will challenge your driving capabilities!

The two new districts, Farelane and Lake Firefly, are available for free to explore for all players, with the progression and upgrading features being exclusive to those who bought the DLC or are owners of the Deluxe Edition / Bus Pass. The new minibus and traffic events are also exclusive parts of the paid DLC.
See the full DLC trailer here.

A new open map mode has been added for free, allowing players to experience the city's full content across different company types from the start, along with other improvements and fixes. Read the full details below!
If you run into any problems, please contact our support team by clicking here.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652091/1761be373ccae182952806a5c412ffe3df3459b6.jpg"]
Has raised suspension and is suitable for rougher, narrower roads. Now available for players to experience in the new areas of the map, and also when driving in the city.

Complete with their own unique environments and scenic views, they are now open for all players to explore, but the progression/tourism/upgrading features are restricted to owners of the Old Town Roads DLC or the Bus Pass.
New road types and traffic events for a fresh, challenging driving experience.
Tractor NPV is added to create authentic traffic around the new areas.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652091/420bdeaf4852b48fa7aecfc77fb8a8f64cf75d4d.jpg"]

A new Open Map mode has been added for players to experience the full content of the city in different types of company, based on the rewards available from the beginning of a new savegame. Classic Company will start a base game content company, and Open Map will start a company based on the selected options:
No Extras: Every reward needs to be unlocked, besides bridges and bus stops.
All Rewards: All buses, customization items, perks, and drive modifiers are already unlocked. With the Sightseeing DLC, all sights are also unlocked here.
Buses and Customization: All buses and customization items are already unlocked. Perks and drive modifiers need to be unlocked.
Customization: All customization items are already unlocked. Buses, perks, and drive modifiers need to be unlocked.
The unlocked availability of Open Map Mode will be highlighted via a pop-up in the Office menu, after players have completed the New Heights Celebration Tour.

notes.title: A pack of new customization layers

items.text: 8 new bottom layers.
13 new top layers.
A decorative, parked Horizon Chamois will be at the depot parking lot when the player owns the Old Town Roads DLC.
Quality of Life Updates
Increased traffic density in the Outer City districts to avoid an empty car pumpjack area.
NPVs can overtake the player’s bus again and should now smoothly bypass it when serving a bus stop.
Two cars on the loading screen from the Main Menu to the Office were adjusted to look more visually consistent with the rest of the game.
Made the airport terminal entrances look smaller and more natural based on player feedback.
Slightly wet roads with some puddles are now present during shifts after a very rainy/wet weather.
The curbs at the Curtain Raise Fields have been replaced with wooden ones to fit the sidewalk.
Made some adjustments to the Nodding Donkeys stop so the Double-Bendy won’t make a small bump on the right.
Removed and adjusted several assets in High Rise for better Double-Bendy drivability.
Simplified collision detection for all generated road curbs and bus stop curbs to eliminate severe, often unexpected collisions with the player’s bus when it is close to the sidewalk or a bus stop.
The Belvedere Station area of the Culture District upgrade now has a 20-mph speed limit.
Upgraded the pavement in the Ashtree district.
Tweaked many of the speed limit and prohibition-of-turn-and-entry signs to look nicer and comply with traffic rules.
Moved some street lamps in the tourist district to allow the Double-Decker to move past the street without colliding with them.
Speed bumps are now also triggered by traffic rules when the bus is driving in reverse.
Tweaked the Harsh Braking brake time to feel more forgiving for small buses.
Added a fixed keyboard/gamepad steering mode.
Camera input is now blocked while the game is paused.
Steering, throttle, and brake linearity now apply to keyboard and controller.
Adjusted the Map border mesh for the zoomed-out view so that Curtain-Raise Fields can be selected with a controller.
Swapped the FFB values of dirt and sand to make dirt the rougher surface.
Slightly increased the StonePlate FFB.
Ignition FFB is now enabled.
The Horizon 60ft Dashboard should now have the radio SM visible again.
Reduced the Futz radio effect on bus stop announcements.
Fixed a crash when creating an MP session on PlayStation.
Fixed a random crash when upgrading the Ashtree district.
Fixed an issue with clients joining the session after the title was suspended and resumed.
Fixed an issue with Bendy bus collisions and the Depot barrier (now the barrier shouldn’t close on Bendy buses).
Fixed an issue with Horizon Bendy’s dynamic shadow.
Triggering the ramp within the cockpit won’t slow the bus down anymore.
Fixed an animation issue with the sunblinds on Horizon Hydrogen buses so they do not block the entire windshield.
Wipers of Horizon 60ft should now work again.
Radio visible on Horizon 60ft again.
Tweaked some buses' cockpit textures to improve performance.
Bus dashboard LODs now have higher resolution and load faster.
Xbox Series S cockpit textures got a major quality boost.
Implemented various pedestrian fixes and optimizations to eliminate issues in the pumpjack area.
Fixed wrong and inconsistent Victory Lap request and line names.
Fixed an issue with objects HLOD popping around the Airport area and Mining Town.
Moved some Airport area advertising posters to avoid merging with buildings.
Changed the Flight Control Tower so that the top/head is no longer part of HLODs.
Fixed some passenger pathing in the Outskirts and Airport areas.
Fixed some issues related to gamepad vibrations on PC.
Fixed some issues related to missing German voice lines.
Fixed various localization bugs in the Codex.
Added new Tourist and Map Codex entries.
Fixed some issues related to river name translations on the map to ensure consistency with landmark and street naming.
Fixed some issues related to traffic density in the low-lane and turn areas of the Outskirts.
Adjusted various traffic events and the traffic density in the Airport area to prevent despawning or empty roads.
NPVs should no longer drive through their surroundings, nor should they take unpredictable trajectories.
Thank you for playing Bus Bound and for all of your support. 🙌
Let us know what you think of this update, and we hope you have fun exploring the old town's rural routes! 🏞🚐
-stillalive and Saber

items.text: The Old Town Roads update is arriving September 15 for Bus Bound. 🗓✅
Get ready to serve lakeside resorts and mines, and tackle new challenges behind the wheel of the Horizon “Chamois” minibus! 🚐🏆
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652091/dee5ffec39ca71c92e551a3748344c408e69545b.jpg"]
Today, we are releasing a hotfix for Bus Bound across all platforms, including fixes for the Hidden Gems Tour DLC and the free Outskirts map extension.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652091/7fe11d581b4328780c91e90f8fa524d5424e9bcb.png"]
Horizon Hydrogen Double 80ft and Horizon Hydrogen 60ft Gen2 should now be available free and unlocked for all players.
Fixed an issue where passengers were reacting before embarking on their Tourist drive.
Free Roam drive now starts without any softlocks for both the host and client.
A missing traffic light was added to the Outskirts area.
Team Bus Bound 🚌💛

Today, we are releasing a patch for Bus Bound on all platforms that adds free content, including a new map and two new buses. You can access these after opening all the bridges on the main map. You will unlock the ‘Emberville Outskirts’, which connects to multiple parts of the city.
This new area includes new bus stops, a new highway, and new locations, such as an airport. While the outskirts don't feature an upgrade, all bus stops offer new bus customization rewards to unlock.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652091/02c9fc50f7aa9560bf963696a2a553b721ca0e61.png"]
Get ready to also drive the Horizon Hydrogen Double 80ft and Horizon Hydrogen 60ft Gen2, two unique articulated buses that offer ample space to maximize your passenger throughput.

The new paid DLC brings the ‘Sightseeing’ game mode, specifically designed to test your understanding of the city. Experience passenger service in entirely new ways while also driving the new Horizon Sightseer Gen2.
Check out the DLC trailer here ⤵️⤵️
The update also brings quality-of-life improvements, addresses bus mastery issues, and more. The full details are below!
If you run into any problems, please contact our support team by clicking here.
A new vast area - Emberville Outskirts - has been added. Three new subzones expand opportunities to build long, interesting routes.
You are able to unlock the Outskirts following the progression of the base game. Do this by maxing out the Fairview bus stop in Windfall Oaks and unlocking all the bridges.
40+ events are added to the new areas to make them feel more lively.
Road connections in the Belvedere, Ashtree, Transit, and The Strings districts have been upgraded for smooth access to the Airport.
New Airport DLC skins are added.
On the Drive map, there are now a couple of planes flying above the Airport.
Ad billboards under the bridge are now emissive, lighting up the surroundings at night.
New buses are added: Horizon Hydrogen Double 80ft and Horizon Hydrogen 60ft Gen2.
You can now drive along tourist routes to explore Emberville's sights and learn more about the city's story.
Tourist Drives have different difficulty levels based on the number of unlocked bus stops and challenge players’ knowledge of the city to optimize navigation.
Tourist routes are embedded in the base game progression: A new tourist route appears every day in the morning shift.
A new bus has been added for the most immersive tourist route experience: Horizon Sightseer Gen2.
Tourist Drives are available in multiplayer.
Tourist drives have their own Satisfaction/Mood meter and progression for the stops.
Passengers have new sparkle reactions when leaving the bus while in a Tourist Drive.
A new ‘Post Cards’ section has been added to the Office menu, where you can get different cards as rewards for sightseeing drives.
Basic gameplay features are also available and trackable throughout the Tourist Drives, enabling seamless progression through the game (Bus masteries and corresponding Achievements).
Drive Events are adjusted around the city to optimize traffic.
Taxi NPVs have been brought back to the High Rise base level.
Traffic density in the Outer City has increased.
Onboarding popups saved in the player profile are now only visible once, until you reset them in Settings.
Player Avatars are now loaded and visible on Steam, PlayStation 5, and XBOX.
Bus backgrounds are replaced with new, unified screenshots (Drive Map/End of Drive screen).
Some lights have been added to the Bohm statue to make it more visible at night.
Fixed the spawn weight of some pedestrian-only populations. This should prevent the spawning of police officers in large numbers.
Tweaked some environmental assets around new areas to load smoothly and seamlessly for the player.
Tweaked the lighting around Emberville to optimize memory usage and provide a more natural look.
Added a ‘Signal Ahead’ pavement painting to warn about traffic lights along high-speed limit roads.
Added UVS for Ride buses.
Several tweaks were made to steering wheel controls and bindings:
Wait for enhanced user input settings to be loaded.
Keep previously seen steering wheels if none are attached.
Apply the previous preset default even if no steering wheel is attached.
The door button of the Horizon 60ft changed from opening just Door 3 to all doors. Now, you can control the first two doors individually and open the rest.
The Horizon 60ft Diesel now has a smoke effect for exhaust.
Welsh audio language is now available on PC.
Bus Masteries are now initialized with the correct progression level on save/load, so they are tracked and displayed correctly.
Skipped masteries won't be recovered, but new saves won't have the issue anymore.
Bus Masteries progress is now shown according to the current drive.
Bendy buses on the client's side now teleport again after spawning, fixing the issue where bendy buses sometimes get stuck.
Celebration drives now start in their appropriate weather and shift.
The “Transit Crossing” achievement is fixed on PlayStation 5.
Fixed LOD issues with the rear of the K11, and the middle section has been re-weighted to achieve higher-fidelity bending.
Adjusted the Ride K9MDER floor collider to be higher off the ground.
Improved bus cockpit texture sharpness.
Electrip Letenda no longer jumps upwards when using the "Respawn Bus" function.
Passengers are now boarding the Ride buses correctly, without getting stuck in doors.
Fixed the set dressing characters that were causing issues in the Belvedere District.
Fixed the clouds on the map in the Drive and Pause menus so they have their natural form.
Fixed the XBOX Series X preset button binding.
The steering wheel settings are no longer reset when the PlayStation 5 is restarted while the steering wheel is connected.
Added a ‘beep’ sound to the kneeling of buses where it was missing.
The loud sound of Horizon Gen1 has been fixed.
Expanded the player’s guide to include additional pictures and content.
Fixed the "Press any button..." screen that remained in the settings menu, on top of all other screens, when the multiplayer session was full on PlayStation 5.
PROS is now correctly loading on PC.
The EULA that appeared twice on Steam has been fixed.
The list of perks in the stats menu is now scrollable with the controller.
The bridge blocker icons no longer duplicate when returning to line selection.
The radio widget is now disabled when all HUD tips are disabled in settings.
Multiplayer mode is now correctly activated when the player purchases PlayStation®Plus.
The game no longer softlocks when reassigning the steering button in Controls after restarting (consoles only).
Thank you for continuing to support Bus Bound! 🙏 We are looking forward to hearing what you think of this update.
We are working away on another map expansion and new DLC. Keep an eye on our social media channels for more. Make sure to discover all of those hidden gems in the meantime! 🚌🔎
-stillalive and Saber

items.text: Today, we have a hotfix for Bus Bound on PC that fixes the harsh braking issue. ⚒️ The team is addressing other issues as well. Stay tuned for more news on that!
If you run into any issues in the game, please contact our support team at https://support.saber.games/hc/en/bus-bound/articles/how-to-report-an-issue-1.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652091/92ce7f786895bd7a8db1e1a42a4cc3a4845b5539.png"]
Today, along with the new content drop, we are releasing a patch that includes multiple quality-of-life updates, gameplay improvements, steering wheel fixes, and new features based on your feedback.
If you run into any issues in the game, please contact our support team via this form.
New RIDE buses were added to the game - K9MD-ER 40' and K11M 60'.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652091/52024c13a9a337ccbecd1555f8eded2528497da9.jpg"]
Check out the DLC trailer here: [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/hwm1pf1vY-Y"]
UI
Districts in the Stats screen are now hidden if none of their stops are unlocked or soon to be unlocked.
Added ‘company’ and ‘personal statistics’ screens to the Stats screen.
Like multiplier, stop extra levels, and day count statistics are added to Progress (Office menu).
Gameplay
There is now an option to drive the same route again without returning to the office.
The last upgrade drive is now a special celebration/credits drive.
Overworked harsh breaking - Harsh breaking was rebalanced to be more difficult. Players now need to break more smoothly to not trigger negative reactions from the passengers.
Audio
A radio that uses FMOD to play songs from a disk is added.
Welsh is now a supported VO language on PC.
Settings
Several new settings were added based on players' feedback. Thank you for sending these in!
Setting to permanently show/hide HUD mirrors.
An option to fully disable the crosshair was added.
Option to display speed in KMH.
Options to minimize (or fully hide) any UI element.
Steering Wheels
Updated the button set for Fanatec CSL Elite (PS5).
The supported number of buttons is increased to 128.
The throttle and brake can now be bound to buttons.
Settings
Removed the “absolute keyboard controls” setting.
When assigning buttons, the current key is now only assigned to actions with the correct input type.
Visuals
Screen Space Reflections for Mirrors now turn on at Medium settings (Translucency will only be on with the High Mirror Quality setting).
The dirt texture on NPVs is replaced with a smoother smudge, making it look more natural.
Some loading screen screenshots have been updated for better quality or to showcase new game content.
The screenshot shown before a celebration drive is now also added as a potential loading screen image when a district is upgraded.
Asphalt roads now feature cracks and tar spots.
Audio
The tire-on-the-ground volume has been slightly increased.
End of Drive music is lowered, and it now also plays in streamer mode.
UI
Instead of the Districts' upgrade levels, UI badges for upgraded districts now feature laurels.
There is now a UI hint when muting and switching radio stations.
Line Editor now re-selects the last selected line.
Buses
The colliders of all the buses were adjusted to improve driving quality (to prevent crashing into the ground).
Improvements to buses' overhanging ability.
Driver seat positions are now saved.
Improved left/right looking feature for third-person camera
Improved suspension calculation, making curbs handle better.
UI
Bridge Blockers should now always show the unlocking conditions on the Drive map.
Visuals
Positioning of bus markers on the map is fixed (both for MP and SP).
Passengers should now stay within the bus stop area and not slide on the road/to the side.
Sanitized passenger spawn points on all bus stops.
Passengers only board and alight at open doors.
Adjusted the Office lighting at night to avoid being too dark.
Fixed Office lighting flickering in certain circumstances.
Fixed the garage light flickering on medium GI settings.
Parked buses and cars have more realistic levels of dirt.
Steering Wheels
Fixed the incorrect axis configurations for the T300 on PlayStation.
Fixed the indicator bindings on T300 and T150 PlayStation presets.
Force feedback not working when multiple steering wheels are plugged in is now fixed.
When plugging in a wheel while already in a drive, we now correctly apply preset settings.
No longer potentially softlock on UI action rebind.
Audio
Clio’s VO lines are fixed, so she is now giving the proper introduction to the environment (Garage, Stats, etc.).
Radio functionality is now fixed (an issue where it sometimes stopped playing has been resolved).
Radio stations can now be switched correctly if correspondent buttons are assigned in Settings.
Roads
The path from Ashtree towards Wright’s Crossing and Windfall Oaks on the Nexus Bridge was tweaked to avoid colliding with the road, as it did with certain bus models.
The road along the bus depot and the bus depot itself received a cleanup pass and are now more drivable and visually consistent.
Fixed various sidewalk curbstones not having collision and wrong collision offsets with the road of sidewalk curbstones.
Gameplay
End of Celebration drive screen no longer has the ‘flip direction’ button.
Celebration drives are now heading in the same direction for all players.
When using the “Respawn Bus Onto Road” function, the player’s vehicle will no longer get stuck in environment objects.
Speed limit UI now updates during Free Roam.
Fixed various rewards wrongfully causing the time limit between stops to increase.
Stability
Crash on the initial splash screen (related to Benchmark and PSO Compilation were running at the same time) is fixed.
Localization
Some bus stop translations were fixed to maintain consistency in naming.
Settings
The "User Interface Scale" setting is now saved and stored correctly after restarting the game.
Chromatic Aberration settings are now working correctly.
Thank you for supporting Bus Bound and for your patience while we worked on the new content and game fixes. Until the next stop! 🚍🚏
-stillalive and Saber

items.text: Today, we are releasing a patch for Bus Bound on all platforms that addresses frequently reported gameplay bugs, including fixes for steering wheel issues, stability improvements, and crash and freeze fixes.
If you run into any issues in the game, please contact our support team at https://support.saber.games.
The HORI Truck system shifter should now work in the steering wheel preset.
The Logitech Xbox G920 preset has been fixed and now applies correctly.
Some force feedback behavior has been tweaked, and the Logitech G920 PC preset was improved.
Overshoot prevention on the MOZA R5 and Logitech G920 has been improved.
MOZA PC preset force feedback settings are toned down.
Player Avatar at ‘PlayerProfile’ creation is now randomized.
Speed limits are now more consistent throughout the driving across the bridges and junctions.
Floor collisions with buses have been moved slightly higher to prevent crashing with the ground.
Force feedback on the stone plates is reduced.
Looking left and right now works correctly when the player triggers it frequently.
The glass on the Horizon Hydrogen 40ft Gen2 has been adjusted to fix the flickering artifacts.
Slight increase for Dashboard LOD distances now prevents popping on the dashboard while in first-person view.
The Horizon 60ft meshes are adjusted to improve mirror visibility.
Bottom colliders for the Horizon 40ft H2Gen2 and Sightseer were adjusted for a smoother driving experience across the city.
One standpoint for passenger blocking visibility in the Vicinity Classic 35ft CNG has been removed.
The Horizon CNG mesh clipping at the rear part of the bus is now fixed.
The middle part of the Horizon 60ft can’t get decals anymore, so it always follows the initial design.
The Battery and Recoup needles in the ABP and BP on the Horizon 40ft H2Gen2 dashboard are fixed.
The incorrect speed animation for Horizon Sightseer is fixed.
The incorrect bendy middle section of NFI 60ft Hydrogen has been fixed: it is no longer too short compared to the real-life bus.
The incorrect LOD Threshold for the speed needle of New Flyer Electrics is fixed.
The audio mix for the retarder on Bluebird Sigma is improved.
Colliders of Horizon Sightseer and Velocity Raptor (NPV car) were adjusted to give players a smoother driving experience while maneuvering through the city.
New functions were added to load and store driver seat positions in the bus.
The parked sightseer traffic event now has a collision with the bus.
The parade event in the Education District is fixed: the car and trailer are no longer sinking into the ground.
AI vehicles now evade obstacles and events more naturally, rather than suddenly despawning and creating traffic jams.
AI vehicles' brake lights lighting up all the time is now fixed.
Nighttime map exposure was adjusted. This fixes the total darkness on a drive map during night shifts.
The reflectivity of the interior bus glass has been reduced as it was causing too strong reflections at night.
Afternoon lighting conditions in the office are updated to look more natural.
TSR Anti-Flickering settings were enabled on consoles to reduce flickering.
Some static characters, including the Mascot on the bus stop, were moved out of the ground in the Ashtree district.

Added character randomizer - The character will be generated for your Player Profile and be consistent over all save games and multiplayer sessions you join. The default avatar will now be randomized once for existing profiles.
You can get a new character by deleting your player profile.
Additional work on collision in the High Rise upgraded district has been done to make the driving smoother and more natural.
'Reset to default' button has been added (PC only).
You can now properly apply ‘All Steering Wheel preset settings' on ‘Settings reset’.
The ‘Graphics Quality Settings' section on consoles is now disabled.
PC-specific options have been excluded from ‘Reset’ on consoles.
A rare crash that could happen when a bus teleports is fixed.
Integrated FSR hotfix.
DDC file creation is added to shorten load-up times.
Links fixed.
Resources and styling embedded.
The build documentation has been moved and no longer ships with the Obsidian project.
UV reference textures for skin creation are added.
The translation error in the 'Hall of Fame' stop name is now fixed.
MFG not working: Use "DLSS override - Frame Generation Mode" in the NVIDIA app on 50xx GPUs to fix.
If DLSS FG is not available for 40xx GPUs, check if "Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling" in the Windows System → Display → Graphics settings is enabled.
Thank you for playing Bus Bound and for all the positive sentiment that you have been spreading in the comments and reviews. 🙏🚌
The team is fully dedicated to continue improving your game experience and to listening to feedback. 🙌
Here is what we are working on next, in addition to the first DLC update, "Let's RIDE! Bus Pack," which will include 2 buses from RIDE:
Two RIDE buses: K9MD 40' and K11M 60'.
Option to have a mirror always on/off setting in the game settings.
Option to display speed in KMH.
Option at the end of the line to run the next shift on the same line with the same bus without returning to the office.
Option to fully disable the crosshair.
Thanks again for supporting Bus Bound. See you on the road! 🚍🚏
-stillalive and Saber
Today, we have a hotfix for the new demo that adds more steering wheel presets, multiplayer and visual improvements, as well as other minor fixes.
Steering Wheel Presets
Added more steering wheel presets: T300 RS, Logitech G29, Fanatec CSL Elite, and Thrustmaster TMX.
Updated steering wheel presets and button images for Logitech G923: Improved applying XSX presets and fixed dpad icon assignments.
Fixed an issue where the multiplayer session was not shutting down when the host disconnected.
Improved collisions for players with high ping and/or packet loss.
Fix audio language not setting up correctly at startup.
Replaced some radio music to ensure the afternoon shift doesn't occasionally play silence.
Remove placeholder net engine sound for Horizon Diesel 40ft and 60ft.
Fixed the reaction sound playback in the German language.
Reworked garage lighting to reduce the shadow noise.
Fixed white glass in the Garage.
Fixed super shiny walls in the office during rainy weather.
Fixed bushes not having contact shadows.
Fixed some buses with the interior glass too reflective.
Reworked the Niagara exhaust system so it's possible to remove unused exhaust systems, and changed the transparent glass material to the new one.
Fixed settings issue in the main menu where the ‘Apply Change’ pop-up is only visible while ESC is held down.

items.text: Prepare to team up in 4-player co-op in stillalive studios’s Bus Bound! 👥🚍👥
Help your friends make a positive impact by working together to improve the city. 🌐💪

🛑 https://sabr.gg/BusBoundSteam

[p align="justify"]A City Full of Life: Explore Emberville, a fully simulated, densely inhabited town that comes to life with a dynamic traffic system and distinct day/night and weather conditions. From bustling intersections to quiet neighborhoods, every area has its own rhythm, and your route will help shape its future.

[p align="justify"]Drive American Icons: Take the wheel of true-to-life buses from top American manufacturers, including the New Flyer Xcelsior 40ft CNG and the Blue Bird Sigma. With a growing lineup of over a dozen vehicles at launch, you’ll always have the right bus for the job.

[p align="justify"]Shape the City: You’re not just driving, you’re improving public life! Upgrade stops, unlock new routes, earn passive perks, and see each district evolve into a more vibrant, pedestrian-friendly space.

[p align="justify"]Multiplayer on the Move: Band together with up to three other players in online co-op! Split off to tackle multiple routes simultaneously and contribute to your host’s goal to improve Emberville.

[p align="justify"]Customize Your Fleet: With each shift, you’ll generate goodwill with your riders to unlock new buses, visual styles and upgrades. Whether you prefer a relaxing driving experience or want to master and optimize every detail of your run, the freedom to make each trip your own is yours.
